description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API: any sklearn featurizer plus classifier can be wired in, with probability calibration applied automatically. The default baseline is a calibrated linear SVM.
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own high-confidence gate: only matches the plugin itself scores as high confidence fire, trading recall for precision versus the -medium fighter. Per-plugin config is identical to the -medium fighter.
